description: Dry-run a published tool by name: verdict (pass/will_fail/unverifiable), writes rolled back (dry_run); see host.quickstart.

args.description: Arguments to pass, same shape as a real call. Omit to run one example generated from the tool's args_schema; the response then carries example_args (what ran) and untyped (keys the schema gave no type for).

fixtures.description: Chain tools only: {"<step number or tool name>": <recorded result>}. A fixtured step executes nothing (no upstream call); later mappings resolve against it. host.runs.get(run_id, as_fixtures=true) exports a real run in this shape.

name.description: Local name of the already-published tool to dry-run.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

name: host.tool_test
